Auto-hunt: hunts only inside the zone where you turned it on, seeking the nearest monster and avoiding obstacles. Rewards are slightly lower. Choose what to pick up in Settings
Attack. Near people · buildings · portals · the vault it changes to that name
Skills. Set the slots in the Skills window
Red dot: monster · Orange dot: elite · named · Gold diamond: boss · Sky-blue ring: portal · Green triangle: dungeon entrance · Yellow outline: town
Guard Captain Hagen: quest reports · daily request rewards · building construction

Get close and the attack button changes to their name. Tap to talk. Merchant Orten runs the shop, Jeweler Lien sockets · combines gems, and Sage Era handles the codex · shard grinding · combining · drawing
In front of a building the button changes to its name. Tap it to open the building window. Choose a function with the tabs at the top
Stand on a portal and press the button to choose a destination. Monsters do not spawn near portals
Shared vault chest next to the merchant
Press the button in front of the chest to open the vault
Vault: shared by all characters on the same account. {} slots, expanded by the research "Large Vault"
Tap items to select or deselect. Select several and use the middle button to move them all at once
Stackable items · identical skillbooks · identical shards gather in one slot
Selected item: info · stat changes · use · sell. With nothing selected, equipped gear is shown
Bag: enhancement stones · zone materials also come in as items. They can be used for enhancement · buildings even from the vault
Identical skillbooks stack in one slot. [Absorb One] uses one book, [Use All] uses the whole stack to raise mastery at once. For an unknown skill, one book teaches it and the rest are absorbed
Stat shards with the same affix also gather in one slot. Choose which value to use when refining
Learned skills. Rank rises with use. There is no rank cap, but it slows down from {}
Variants: choose one each at rank {}
{} quick slots: tap a slot to place the skill. A skill already slotted swaps places

Superior and higher skills depend on your weapon. One-handed weapons (+ shield · orb · grimoire) use single-target · dash · spear skills, two-handed weapons (greatsword · staff · greatscepter · tower shield) use swing · area skills. Basic · intermediate · buff skills work with any weapon
Skills you can't use with your current weapon appear dimmed in the quick slots. With a greatscepter, two-handed Spirit spells cost {}× mana but gain power and area
Stats grow with your actions: swinging blades raises Strength, casting spells raises Intelligence, taking hits raises Vitality
Detailed stats. Each Awakening lets you choose a title and trait that fit your style. Higher tiers unlock new traits such as critical · sprint · wave · chain · mark · shield
Equipped arts: Awakening {} {} slot · Awakening {} {} slots · Awakening {} {} slots
Unlocked by performing set actions (melee crits · ranged crits · hitting many enemies, etc.) a set number of times while hunting manually. Auto-hunt does not count
Arts mixing two stats require having earned a title containing both stats
Claim daily request rewards: only in front of Guard Captain Hagen
Completing achievements grants gold and achievement titles
The more monsters you defeat, the more info unlocks, and you gain bonuses such as damage based on kill count
Only characters logged in and saved to the server appear in the rankings
Logs such as completion notices · loot · zone changes. Tapping the log on the left of the screen also opens it
Other adventurers' messages appear in the chat box at the bottom left. Log in and set a nickname, then press [Chat] ({}: {}) to speak
The side button collapses the chat box. Messages received while collapsed are shown as a count. Move it with {} layout editing in Settings
Up to {} characters at a time. Up to three messages per {} seconds, and you can't repeat the same message in a row. Continued spam mutes you for a while, and profanity is filtered
Gold · materials · Awakening · time required per level
Function tabs: Enhance · Refine · Salvage · Mercenaries
Enhance: the level stays the same on failure, and Artisan's Spirit builds up with each failure. Higher-level gear has lower success rates and needs more enhancement stones
Refine: choose gear and a stat shard to replace one affix with the shard's affix. At Smithy Lv.{} you can lock {} affixes
Salvage: pick a grade and salvage all at once with [Salvage by Grade]. Results appear in a result window
Sockets and gems of the selected gear. Removing a gem costs gold
Combine: {} identical gems make one gem of the next grade. You can also combine by grade all at once
Products don't go into your bag automatically. Enter the building and use [Collect]
Production stops when storage is full. Collect when you see the "full" log
Collect finished items yourself with [To Bag] · [To Vault]
Crafting takes time. Up to five can be queued
The Craft tab also makes Greater Enhancement Stones · Uncharted Maps ({} Uncharted Land Fragments)
Exchange tab: trade {} spare herbs for {} other herb, or convert essences to another grade
Duration. Mercenaries working in buildings can't be sent
Hire visiting mercenaries. They change every hour
Higher Lodging levels let you keep more mercenaries. Tired mercenaries rest at the inn to recover HP
Mercenary gear: use [Gear] in the mercenary list to equip items from your bag · vault
Analyze unknown map fragments and upgrade rumor maps in the "Map" tab
Placed relics: {} slots depending on altar level
Relics come from Uncharted Lands. Placed relics grant effects like EXP · damage · production for a period. Higher grades are stronger and last longer
Map. Only places you've visited are revealed
A zone's dungeon opens after defeating its boss (the minimap entrance turns green). The button turns into "Dungeon" at the entrance. Enter with keys from daily requests · occasional boss drops
Defeating the boss at the deepest point unlocks the next tier. Monster level rises by {} per tier, so tier {} is higher than the next zone
Empowered keys · Extreme keys open harder dungeons
After clearing, the attack button turns into Exit. Pick up the loot and press it to leave
Analyzing unknown map fragments from hunting · expeditions in the Laboratory "Map" tab yields Uncharted Land Fragments or rumors. Rumors appear in zones up to two below your highest boss-cleared zone

Wander a rumored zone and a hidden dungeon entrance appears. It's stronger than the zone; clear it to pick one of three treasure chests for gear. Upgrading the map at the Laboratory makes it stronger with better rewards, and mythic gear drops from +{}
Turn {} Uncharted Land Fragments into an Uncharted Map at the Workshop. Unfold the map outside a dungeon to enter the Uncharted Land of one of your boss-cleared zones
Clearing it grants relics and gold. With the "Open Uncharted Path" you can re-enter the same place within {} hours
Once you've cleared bosses in {} or more zones, every evening at {} o'clock monsters flood a zone you haven't hunted in a while (up to {} zones)
Flooded zones can't be reached by portal; you must walk. Entering traps you in a barrier, and defeating all flood monsters and the flood boss purifies it
Flood monsters give no EXP · loot; purifying grants gold · gear · greater enhancement stones · unknown map fragments. The first purification of each zone per week also grants essence
The more flooded zones, the lower town production and the riskier expeditions become
Dungeons · hidden dungeons gain mutations such as Collapsing · Frozen · Burning. After entering, review the mutations and press [Start] to let monsters move

More mutations raise gear level · legendary chance · gold · gems. Extreme dungeons and upgraded hidden dungeons have more mutations. After clearing, time taken · damage dealt · rewards appear in a result window

The higher the World Tier and the harder the dungeon, the more often monsters appear with abilities like Fire-Enhanced · Cold-Enhanced · Vampiric · Teleport · Binding · Curse · Pack. Abilities are shown in [ ] next to their name
More abilities mean more HP and more EXP · loot
Colored areas are about to be hit. It explodes when it fills from the center
If you circle at range, they use ranged attacks such as leaps · snipes

When you die you sometimes drop one piece of gear on the spot. You can go back and pick it up; if you restart or update without picking it up, it returns to your vault
